scope: Correct KY-41C real-device observation from APN to eSIM profile setup/recognition; add detailed eSIM/manual provisioning guidance to device articles; improve desktop/mobile readability.

ky41c_correction.corrected_observation: Y!mobile and SoftBank eSIM profile setup / SIM information recognition on KY-41C was real-device verified; APN setup was not.
official_esim_methods: direct input of connection server address
ky41c_correction.safety: SIM information initialization deletes eSIM information; do not use as a routine add/switch step

manual_entry_policy: Never substitute APN values for eSIM activation/profile values.
Use only carrier-issued SM-DP+/server address, activation code, or confirmation code when the actual device UI asks for it.
If a manual entry control is not documented or displayed, do not infer a hidden/manual method; use carrier QR/app/provisioning.
Treat QR/activation information and EID/IMEI as sensitive operational data and do not publish them.
responsive_changes: smaller mobile article headings and tighter padding
single-column eSIM cards/steps on narrow screens
desktop article content widened to 800px while retaining readable measure

validation.responsive_smoke: 7 representative articles x desktop 1440px and mobile 390px; document scrollWidth == clientWidth on all 14 checks
validation.visual_review: KY-41C desktop and mobile render reviewed; table overflow remains inside table-wrap and page has no horizontal overflow
